packages.notes: Real fix for the Bluetooth name bug: bluez formats its no-name fallback address with hyphens, but the check compared it against the colon-separated address and never matched, so the hyphenated MAC got shown as a name. Fixed the comparison, and devices with no real advertised name now show as "Unknown device" (or "Nearby Apple device" for unnamed Apple BLE broadcasts) instead of a MAC address or being hidden.
